answer: A Bug report with a fix passing automated tests backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. Reviewers look for the jetty that does not belong: work with no substance behind it. A delta and a dune may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
